#: Offline named anchor placement authoring and Body Slots format presentation.
slots.exists: Output already exists; choose a new path: %(path)s
cli.cmd.slots: author named anchor placements offline and export a Body Slots package
cli.opt.slots.mode: workbench mode: mesh inspection or offline slots authoring
cli.opt.slots.project: Body Slots schema-v1 author JSON to load
cli.opt.slots.provider: stable provider identity for a new project
cli.opt.slots.action: repeatable JSON facade action with method and args
cli.opt.slots.recipe: JSON array of facade actions downloaded from Slots mode
cli.opt.slots.out: write authored JSON to a new file
cli.opt.slots.package: write authored .bslots provider package to a new file
page.slotsOffline: Offline authoring. The picture is a reference pose, not a game state. Missing node frames remain unavailable. Save before choosing another mesh or reloading.
page.slotsLoad: Open author JSON or session recipe
page.slotsPosition: Position in anchor coordinates (X, Y, Z)
page.slotsCenter: Access sphere center in placement coordinates (X, Y, Z)
page.slotsCreateHint: Open author JSON or a session recipe, or add a named placement. A loaded skeleton supplies the anchor list.
page.slotsUnavailable: Preview unavailable: no matching valid skeleton NODE frame. No identity frame is substituted.
page.slotsCustomized: Effective geometry includes a temporary override. Author defaults are preserved.
page.slotsPolicyInvalid: Unfinished Body Slots fields: %(fields)s. Author data is preserved; repair these fields before runtime export.
page.slotsMarkers: Orange: access sphere. White: placement origin. Red / green / blue: local X / Y / Z. Uniform anchor scale is applied once.
page.slotsExports: Author JSON and .bslots contain authored definitions only. Session recipes preserve applied edits, local variants, selection and edit target, including unfinished projects. Presets contain only explicit variant fields and optional template identity; a real customizer must bind an actual equipment instance. No runtime instances, inventory or game saves are edited.
slots.outputs: Editor outputs require --editor; authored --out/--package require normal mode. Output paths must be distinct.
slots.presetSelection: Select a local preview variant before exporting an unbound preset.
cli.opt.slots.editor: return generic editor state without requiring finished Body Slots author fields
cli.opt.slots.sessionout: with --editor, write a replayable session recipe to a new file
cli.opt.slots.presetout: with --editor, write the selected variant as an unbound placement preset
page.slotsVariantGroups: Checked groups override inheritance. Apply replaces all variant groups; unchecked groups inherit.
